purpose: teacher capability on the frozen round18 development worlds only: no training, no trained policy, no checkpoint, no teacher labels, no formal gate, no game execution

worlds.load: read-only: the twenty-eight round18 worlds are loaded from the frozen manifest and never regenerated; no parameter is changed, no world is replaced, no budget is added

criterion.loop: identical to round18: tactical_teacher_validation.advance, two logical frames per decision, horizon 160 = eighty decisions, sticky collision, no pixels, no rendering, no game

teachers.driver: the driver owns the physics: every decision is executed with the verifier own advance(); only decide() is called on the teachers. Their rollout() helpers are not used because tactical_teacher.rollout replays through tactical_scenarios.advance, whose coverage/gap/window/threshold are hard-coded defaults and therefore are not this world

metrics.survived: full horizon 160 and no sticky collision
metrics.goal_satisfied: F3: canonical x <= goal at some sampled state; F1/F2: true by the round18 convention, they have no crossing goal
metrics.feasible: survived and goal_satisfied, identical to round18 outcome()
metrics.first_hit: first logical frame with a sticky collision, null if never
metrics.verify: tactical_teacher_validation.verify(world, actions) on the complete eighty-decision sequence, non-early: feasible / rejected_witness / unknown
metrics.counts: reused, not redefined: the six round18 baselines run through round18 policies()/causal_loop()/outcome() and must reproduce the stored manifest

degenerate.definition: an episode whose eighty decisions contain exactly one distinct action is constant; if it is also feasible the success is marked degenerate, reported separately and never counted as teacher capability
degenerate.reason: a constant teacher episode is by construction the same trajectory as the corresponding round18 constant baseline, which already fails on these worlds; the flag keeps that explicit instead of silently crediting it
degenerate.cross_check: every constant episode is compared with the round18 extra_constants probe and must agree, otherwise the run aborts

action_changes.definition: switches = number of consecutive decision pairs with a different action over the eighty decisions; reported per world and summed/averaged per teacher per family

family_verdict.capable: at least one capability success in the family
family_verdict.both_failed: both teachers not_capable: the family is reported as a failure and kept as a failure, next to the round18 reference witness count
family_verdict.no_relaxation: no threshold is loosened, no world is swapped, no teacher is tuned, no action set is widened, no extra attempt is made, no seed is drawn

criterion.reference: read-only: every round18 reference witness is replayed with verify() to show the family is solvable at all; this is a contrast, never a success criterion for a teacher

split.rule: one group = base + mirror, atomic; within each family the groups are ordered by group name (candidate index) and alternate train/validation starting with train at index 0
split.f2: two groups only: index 0 train, index 1 validation
assertions: base and mirror are always in one group and therefore in one split
fourteen groups and twenty-eight events, no event in two groups
seven train and seven validation groups, fourteen and fourteen events

execution.overwrite: directories are created with exist_ok=False and every JSON is opened in x mode
execution.reruns: exactly one evaluation run; no rerun, no retune, no repair pass

split.rule: alternate the family-internal group index, train at index 0
